fact: OECD OPSI says government e-services such as the MoKloud digital safe use MauPass 2FA, which needs prior KYC registration, to confirm users' identity, with name and ID number validated against the Central Population Database.

OECD OPSI says government is integrating MauPass across e-services, naming learner's licence application, Public Service Commission posts, MoRendezVous booking, Supreme Court portal, e-payslip, e-HR leave and online motor vehicle licence payment; date is the page's published year, the document giving none for this.

Bank of Mauritius Governor said two tripartite MoUs were signed on 15 April 2022 with the Registrar of Civil Status, the Police and the ICT ministry so that the Central KYC system, with the Bank as gateway, lets banks and financial institutions verify customer identity against the Central Population Database via InfoHighway.

L'Express reports that since 29 September 2026 licence holders (about 884,000) can view their digital driving licence on the KOREK! app, with MauPass providing the identification and authentication and police systems the data.
